description: This Kotlin source file implements motion activity and pedometer handling for an Android app within the ai.openclaw.app.node package. It includes data classes, a data source interface, an internal system data source, and a MotionHandler class that manages motion-related queries and permissions.

classes.name: MotionDataSource
classes.description: Interface defining methods for motion activity and pedometer data sources, including checks for availability and permission, and methods to retrieve activity and pedometer data.

classes.name: MotionActivityRequest
classes.description: Data class representing a request for motion activity data, with optional start and end ISO timestamps and a limit.

classes.name: MotionPedometerRequest
classes.description: Data class representing a request for pedometer data, with optional start and end ISO timestamps.

classes.name: MotionActivityRecord
classes.description: Data class representing a record of detected motion activity, including start/end timestamps, confidence, and activity type booleans.

classes.name: PedometerRecord
classes.description: Data class representing pedometer data, including start/end timestamps, steps, distance, and floors.

classes.name: SystemMotionDataSource
classes.description: Internal singleton object implementing MotionDataSource using Android sensors, providing methods to check sensor availability, permissions, and to perform activity and pedometer readings.

classes.name: MotionHandler
classes.description: Main class handling motion activity and pedometer requests, managing permissions, parsing input JSON, and invoking data source methods.

methods.name: handleMotionActivity
methods.description: Handles motion activity requests by checking permissions, parsing input, and returning activity data wrapped in GatewaySession.InvokeResult.

methods.name: handleMotionPedometer
methods.description: Handles pedometer data requests similarly, checking permissions, parsing input, and returning pedometer info in GatewaySession.InvokeResult.

methods.name: isAvailable
methods.description: Checks whether motion capabilities are available on the device.

methods.name: isActivityAvailable
methods.description: Checks if activity detection is available.

methods.name: isPedometerAvailable
methods.description: Checks if pedometer functionality is available.

methods.name: parseActivityRequest
methods.description: Parses JSON input into a MotionActivityRequest object with default values.

methods.name: parsePedometerRequest
methods.description: Parses JSON input into a MotionPedometerRequest object.
